note: All vectors are synthetic. Kotlin and Dart tests concatenate inputParts and expectedParts. Each part has at most eight characters so source fixtures do not contain complete provider-key or PEM shapes. Full disk and export redaction cut each ANSI-stripped line at 2000 UTF-16 code units without splitting a surrogate pair; live logs keep their token-only rule.
